source: Vinokurova N. Lexical Categories and Argument Structure: A Study with Reference to Sakha. Utrecht, 2005. (LOT Dissertation Series, no. 103)
topic: Extending H&K's proposal to denominal verb formation in Sakha
notes: Although this analysis seems plausible, it stumbles upon directional LAA-verbs such as the one in (10a) paraphrasable as (10b). As suggested by the paraphrase, the derivation of kuorattaa 'go to the town' in (10a) should involve incorporation of the noun kuorat 'town' to PDAT and then to V. In this case the analysis in (9a) cannot be correct.
